- Posts: creators' posts, polls and picture sets, on a new Posts tab on channels and mixed into your Home and Subscriptions feeds
- Vote in polls and like posts; open a post to read and write its comments
- Channel banners are bigger: the full TV-size picture on a rounded card, clear of the camera cutout
- Sort a channel's videos and lives by Latest, Popular or Oldest
- "More" on a channel opens in the channel's own colors
- Search shows the one channel you're after on top, and its other channels further down as compact rows, like YouTube
